entries.scope: Repository-wide RL-SE self-assessment evidence and Level 0 security-navigation entry
entries.rationale: The feature publishes a corrected bilingual assessment of the complete current Level 0 repository, not only its documentation delta. The security index therefore requires a direct reader path and governed evidence whose status counts, risks, and remediation candidates match the repository-wide matrix.
entries.navigationImpact: docs/security/README.md adds a clearly labelled Level 0 path to the summary first and the full matrix second; historical Feature 024 evidence is unchanged.
entries.languageStrategy: Complete German first, followed by complete English in each changed Markdown document
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Content is platform-neutral Markdown. The repository inventory covers Bash, PowerShell, Python, C#, workflows, security documents, architecture, cryptography, dependencies, AI-development tools, privacy, and sandbox surfaces. Source, mapping, preset, intake, Documentation Impact, and state validation use the macOS Bash path first and PowerShell 7 parity where specified. Semantic DE/EN and feature-scoped link checks provide text-first reader-path evidence; they are not human accessibility tests.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Any change to the twelve canonical checklists, complete Level 0 repository scope, code or I/O surfaces, baseline or mapping versions, installed preset matrix, external or repository evidence freshness, result paths, language structure, or Documentation Impact governance.
